from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/450-9/1_450-9_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/450-9_0_9799d448/1_450-9_output.xlsx")

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Data"]

# Answer range is exactly A2:C150.
start_row, end_row = 2, 150
start_col, end_col = 1, 3

# Header is required to remain in row 2.
header = [ws.cell(row=2, column=c).value for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1)]

# Read the original data before making any changes.
# Data starts at row 3; use full available rows so inserted labels can fill down to row 150.
original_rows = []
for r in range(3, ws.max_row + 1):
    vals = [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1)]
    if any(v is not None for v in vals):
        original_rows.append(vals)

# Build the desired output for A2:C150:
# row 2 header, then blank/blank/group-label rows before each new first character in Employer Name.
output_rows = [header]
last_label = None

for vals in original_rows:
    employer = vals[2]
    if employer is None:
        label = None
    else:
        stripped = str(employer).strip()
        label = stripped[0].upper() if stripped else None

    if label and label != last_label:
        output_rows.append([None, None, label])
        last_label = label

    output_rows.append(vals)

    if len(output_rows) >= (end_row - start_row + 1):
        break

# Trim to the exact writable range height.
output_rows = output_rows[: end_row - start_row + 1]

# Clear only A2:C150.
for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value = None

# Write only within A2:C150.
for i, row_vals in enumerate(output_rows, start=start_row):
    for j, val in enumerate(row_vals, start=start_col):
        ws.cell(row=i, column=j).value = val

# Ensure any remaining cells in A2:C150 stay blank if output is shorter.
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
